QUOTE: Don't hand-edit the switch blocks in `library/error.c`. They sit between `/* Begin Auto-Generated Code. */` and the end of the table, and are generated by `scripts/generate_errors.pl`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says error.c is generated by generate_errors.pl, but it never names error.fmt as the template. It says the input filename is unknown, and it wrongly places the new entry in `data_dir`. The item needs the template to be named.
